item.title: Funko Pop!: Here’s Where to Buy Bluey & Her Fellow Friends Collection Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, pop culture fans. Welcome to our latest update. Today, we're excited to share some news that's sure to delight both kids and adults alike. The lovable characters from the popular animated show Bluey have just gotten the Funko Pop treatment."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Funko, the renowned collectible manufacturer, has launched a new line of Bluey toys featuring all your favorite characters, from Bluey and her little sister Bingo to some of the more niche characters from the show. These vinyl toys are now available for preorder on Funko's website and Amazon, with estimated shipping times ranging from mid-July to early August."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Prices for these adorable collectibles range from $6.99 to $39.99, with most pieces retailing at $14.99. If you're looking to add some Bluey charm to your shelf, you can check out some of our top picks. There's the jumbo 10-inch Bluey toy, priced at $39.99, which is a must-have for any serious fan. Or, if you're feeling lucky, you can try your hand at the Mystery Mini Bluey Pack, which contains one random mini character out of 12, all for just $6.99."
[Short music transition]
Host: "We're also loving the POP Animation figurines, featuring Bluey and Bingo in their creative dress-up outfits. You can get Bingo as 'Granny Rita' or Bluey as 'Granny Janet', each priced at $14.99. These fun and playful designs are sure to bring a smile to any Bluey fan's face."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. If you're interested in getting your paws on these new Bluey Funko Pops, be sure to check out the links on our website. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next update."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
